title: Express Warranty
description: Definition of Express Warranty under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.legal_definition: any material statement, affirmation of fact, promise or description relating to a product or service warranting that it conforms to such material statement, affirmation, promise or description and includes any sample or model of a product warranting that the whole of such product conforms to such sample or model
content.plain_language: a promise or statement made about a product or service that it will meet certain standards or descriptions, including samples or models that represent the whole product
examples: A company advertises that their product is 'durable and long-lasting'
A salesperson shows a customer a sample of a product and says it represents the quality of the whole product
non_examples: A company's general statement that they strive for quality
A customer's personal opinion about a product
